items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I heard Ray Nance when Earl Hines came out here to Los Angeles before I ever left here.

ctx.x: Yeah. Tiny Parham, Erskine Tate, Charles Elgar. I'm sure there's more. John Letmann -- that's where Ray Nance was working the floor show when he joined Duke. dope.
